nom: Paula's Choice Skin Recovery Enriched Calming Toner

avis.titre: It stopped my skin irritation almost instantly, I’m floored rn.
avis.texte: I’ve been using this toner regularly since I got it, last night I used another toner (Tea Time...not bad still just not life changing)) and a buffet of products on my face, most of which were hyaluronic acid niacinamide glycolic and vitamin c (I might avoid aha/vit c combo in the future) I woke up at three in the morning to use the loo and get some water and noticed my face was itchy... I looked in the mirror... my face was red around my mouth and underneath my eyes... I got my water went back to bed and tried not to touch it, when I woke up I could tell the skin was swelling around my mouth, nothing crazy but very concerning nonetheless bc a week before I had this same issue with my eyes, I suspect the vit c that most likely caused this issue, it was a very high concentrate and the only thing I used on both days my face acted up, sorry for the rant, anyways... I ordered this toner bc I was desperate to get my skin back on track, it was still dry and flaky from what happened the week before, that along with the cere ve pm moisturizer has helped me greatly and I should have stuck to that regimen for at least two weeks instead of jumping back to my stronger products, so anyways I washed my face real well (hydro boost cleanser, not my fave but never messes with my skin) and put this toner on... almost instant relief... within five minutes the itching was gone and the redness dissipated, I am so grateful for this product right now, if you’re using vitC/AHA/BHA/PHA products this i

This is my FAVORITE thing I use in my skincare. I have extremely sensitive skin but also acne prone, and this is so light, and I can literally feel it calming my skin down. It is a very light toner, so no worries about it clogging pores or anything. I put it on as soon as I get out of the shower, and my skin just soaks it up. It had made my acne better(because of less irritation) and my skin more evenly toned. Not to mention it makes my face super soft. It has a light scent, but it’s very very mild and doesn’t bother me at all. I have eczema and rosacea, and this is perfect for calming breakouts. I will never not have it in my skincare inventory.

avis.titre: Love Paula’s choice this is the same as years ago, soothing and simple!
avis.texte: I have used Paula’s choice since the early 2000’s and her products were so amazing! They have changed her line so much now it is really just a shell of what it was and the prices are ridiculous compared how Paula ran the company. Thankfully the skin recovery line has largely stayed the same, her bha exfoliant has stayed about the same and her resist cleanser stayed the same… so far. This toner is soothing, light and really helps to take the last traces of makeup and sunscreen off. It is so nice and my skin does not turn red. I have been experimenting with Korean skincare products with beautiful results so I like to keep my toner nice and light- this is it.

I have used SO many toners in the past and after using this one for the past 2 months, I don’t know if I’ll ever stray to another one (except maybe trying the other Paula’s choice one). Makes my skin so well hydrated and silky smooth feeling, absorbs instantly and leaves a beautiful glow. I absolutely love this product. It could probably replace moisturizer for people with oily skin. I have combo skin and it’s perfect. Definitely recommend.

Seems like a good product, definitely no discomfort during the usage, however at the same time acne is not gone or getting better, just same. Not much difference with lotion I’ve used before. With the price point I’ve expected more effect.
My favorite skin care item I own. My skin is always dry after I shower and this immediately makes my skin feel hydrated and soft
This single handedly changed my face wash routine. Didn't realize how bad I needed a toner and this is makes my skin so bright and soothes my redness. Love Paula's Choice so much.

I have extremely sensitive skin, it's very dry, large pours and I break out as a result of a number of products. This has made a significant difference in my complexion and it doesn't break me out. I am so thankful I found this. It's particularly good when paired with a moisturizer.
This is a soothing toner. It’s not at all drying or astringent like some toners. It’s great for my sensitive skin, mature skin.

Love love love Thank you for making me feel less scary about getting older ((47)) *perfect for sensitive skin that is easily effected by ingredients (There’s two kinds of sensitive) *people that have skin problems *people that have issues with ingredients I’m the second one I need something that is not harsh for me and for my older skin *dryness *unevenness in skin tone ( dry patches / little red around the nose and discoloration under eyes I can’t express how much I love this product I went all out and bought everything except cleanser (because I still had some) however I’m going to buy that too Check out my picture Everything I bought is for dry / sensitive skin This is the first time I found a toner that actually fits what it preaches my skin is easily effected by always drying out this product has done the opposite *feel soft /clean *moisturizing *helpful *perfectly priced I can see the difference and the ingredients they paired together is genius

If ppl are wondering why the toner comes in a pink bottle and not the white-pink one, look at the description section when you scroll down. Yes it’s the real one. They definitely need to update the pic. I’ve used many toners throughout my life and this one has given me the BEST experience! It’s my first time splurging on a toner like this one and I’m so glad I have. They feeling on my skin doesn’t dry it out. In fact, I feel more moisturized after using it. I’m definitely going to keep this at my home for a while.

I am a skincare junky. I do reviews on IG & Cherie so when I came across this toner I was so excited to share. I really love Paulas Choice line of products, but I love a great toner. Having comb/oily skin, I find this is perfect. It hydrating and calming enough to not be overbearing! Highly recommend to anyone with dry, sensitive, or compromised skin. It works like a charm

avis.titre: No lo apliques con algodón,, aplicalo con tus manos ✋️ con poco de presion.
avis.texte: Muy buen producto. E visto opiniones con personas que dicen que les a causado rojes en la cara. Yo tengo piel mixta a seca y propensa a rosácea. A veces en mi área de mejillas se pone roja. Pero lo que e aprendido y me a funcionado, es colocar en mis manos el Tónico luego mezclarlo y aplicarlo en mi cara dando poquita presión pero NO arrastrando el producto. NO USES ALGODÓN, ESO TE HARA QUE TE RAYES LA CARA Y LO CUAL HARÁ QUE TE PONGA ROJA LA PIEL SENSIBLE. Hazlo así como te explico y además selecciona bien el siguiente serum que vas usar y la crema y protector solar. Para referencia 1.Agua termal 2.Tonico 3.Serum( Doble serum de Clarins 4.Crema hidratante 5. Protector solar.
I had to wait almost for 1 week to receive, and I when I finally got it, was big fail, the cup was broken 😞, I wanted to return, but, I really need it as mine was finish. I decide to leave

I had high hopes for this toner. I have rosacea and very, very sensitive skin, so I thought this toner would be great for my skin. As a result... I had a very bad reaction to it. I broke out in hives and had to go to the doctor because my face burned and itch terribly. Be careful if you’re planning on getting this toner.
I used this twice. Both times my face turned bright red. I quit using it and within a day I had bumps all over my face. Complete junk! I am going to have to go to the doctor bc of this!!!
